APR-STREAM-005.reason: A rule on what a reader declines to infer from where a record sits. The driver protocol reports outcome, diagnostic, digest, warnings, evaluated and written, and none of those says what an attestation resolved to, so a stream in which position misleads reads as valid to a positional reader and a digest one alike; an example could only assert what both answer. The out-of-order fixture is built to separate them — an attestation first, then two byte-identical copies of the form its subject digest names — and four SDK suites read it and assert unverifiable with two form records surviving. Unresolved is what a reader consulting only preceding records reports, valid is what a reader letting a leading attestation vouch for what follows reports, and one record is what a reader reading the second occurrence as a revision reports. The chronology clause has no assertion of its own; the fixture carries no time to misread.
